Common seadragon or weedy seadragon (Phyllopteryx taeniolatus) at the Scarborough SEA LIFE Sanctuary in England.
Close up head detail of a juvenile sea dragon.
Phyllopteryx taeniolatus, Mornington P'sula - South, AU-VI, AU, 2025-11-23 (iNaturalist).

The weedy sea dragon is the marine state emblem for Victoria and a spectacularly camouflaged relative to the seahorse. We are lucky enough to have a resident population in Western Port Bay, Mornington
